CONFIDENTIAL

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 9413
S.I, Special Branch Station, 9 39

REPORT
Date September 4th 39.

Subject... Assassination of Wong Long Sih (王阆仙), at Lane 1699 Bubbling
Well Road.

Made by. D.S.I. Liao Chung-chien, Forwarded by. C Crawford S.I.

Discreet enquiries elicit that the deceased.
Wong Long Sih (王阆仙), who was assassinated on
September 1, 1939 in Lane 1699 B'well Road, was up
to time of his death, employed with the Shipping
Control Office of the "Shanghai City Government" as
a tax collector and was stationed on a boat which
plies in Soochow Creek near Jessfield Village. He
left his home daily at 6 a.m. and returned at 9 p.m.

The motive for the assassination has not yet
been ascertained but a perusal of the documents found
on the person of the deceased shows that he was in
all probability, a secret service agent operating
on behalf of the Chungking Government in the Japanese
occupied areas where he, being outwardly a "Shanghai
City Government" official, was permitted free passage.

The names and addresses on the documents
found on the person of the deceased have been checked
but none are on record in this office.

A translation of the documents is attached
to this report.

（左侧批注及印章：）
（印：IMMIGRATION OFFICE - A SEP 1939 SPECIAL BRANCH）

报告
日期：1939年9月4日。

事由……王阆仙（Wong Long Sih）在静安寺路1699弄被暗杀案。

制作人：侦探副督察廖仲坚（Liao Chung-chien），转呈人：首席督察克劳福德（C Crawford S.I.）。

经 discreet enquiries（审慎调查）获悉，死者
王阆仙（Wong Long Sih），于1939年9月1日在静安寺路1699弄被暗杀，
生前受雇于“上海市政府”航运管制办公室，担任税务员，
派驻在苏州河兆丰公园（Jessfield Village）附近航行的船只上。他每天
早上6点离家，晚上9点返回。

暗杀动机尚未查明，但查阅在死者身上发现的文件显示，
他极有可能是代表重庆政府在日占区活动的情报人员，
因其表面身份为“上海市政府”官员，故获准自由通行。

已核对死者身上文件中的姓名和地址，但本处均无记录。

本报告附有这些文件的译文。

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
commented on by investigating officer).

At 9.10 p.m. 1/9/39 S.I.C.600 brought to the
station a public ricsha containing a female Wong
Hsu Sz (王許氏) and her husband Wong Long Sih
(王龍山), the latter suffering from a bullet wound
in the head.

A S.F.S. Ambulance was summoned at once and
conveyed the wounded man to the Red Cross Hospital
where he was found to have a "Gun shot wound of
head", as a result of which he died at 11.10 p.m.
even date.

Enquiries by C.J.S.163, C.D.C.s 150 & 168 and
the undersigned showed that the deceased was a native
of Huchow, Chekiang province, age 37, and till 1938
was employed by a native bank in Huchow. Last year
he together with his family left Huchow and in August
1938 came to Shanghai via Changsha and Hongkong and
since his arrival resided at house No.83, Lane 1699
Bubwell Road.

The members of his household were carefully
interrogated by detectives, but failed to supply
any useful information, stating that the deceased
did not inform them of his affairs. The deceased's
wife said that her husband expected to get some
employment at a dance-hall that was to be opened
soon, but she did not know either the names of the
promoters or the location of the said dance-hall.

At about 7 p.m. 1/9/39, the deceased came home
and told his wife that he had to go to Huchow on
2/9/39 and that he would stay overnight in a lodging
house, and asked his wife to pack his bedding and

备注
（任何突出或特殊的特征需由调查警官评论）。

1939年9月1日晚9:10，印度巡捕600号将一辆载有女性王许氏（Wong Hsu Sz）及其丈夫王龙山（Wong Long Sih）的公共人力车带到巡捕房，后者头部受枪伤。

立即召来救火会救护车，将伤者送往红十字会医院，经诊断为“头部枪伤”，并于当晚11:10死亡。

经华人警探163号、华人侦探150号和168号以及署名人的调查，死者系浙江湖州人，37岁，直至1938年在湖州一家钱庄任职。去年他与家人离开湖州，于1938年8月经长沙和香港来到上海，抵沪后一直居住在静安寺路1699弄83号。

侦探对其家庭成员进行了仔细讯问，但未能提供有用信息，称死者并未告知其事务。死者妻子说，她丈夫指望在一家即将开业的舞厅找份工作，但她既不知道发起人的名字，也不知道该舞厅的位置。

1939年9月1日晚7点左右，死者回家告诉妻子，他将于1939年9月2日前往湖州，并将在旅馆过夜，让妻子打包他的寝具和

the deceased went out and called a public ricksha from
B'well Road. The ricksha came to the back door of house
No.83, lane 1699 B'well Road.

Ong Long Sin then sat in the ricksha, and his
sister-in-law Ong Sih Oz (王徐氏) and his wife brought
out his luggage and placed onto the same ricksha, after
which the deceased bade them farewell and ordered the
ricksha puller to go. The females returned into the house
and the ricksha proceeded towards B'well Road.

When the ricksha was about half-way between the
deceased's house and the entrance to the lane (about 50
yards south of B'well Road) two male Chinese, approached
the ricksha from behind and one of them fired a shot at
the back of the deceased's head, after which they ran
south along the lane, turning into a branch-lane leading
to Avenue Haig.

The deceased's wife and sister-in-law heard the
explosion and ran out (they claim they believed the
explosion was caused by burst ricksha tire) and saw two
men running south along the lane. One of the men was
wearing white jacket and pants, whilst the other wore
dark coloured jacket and pants. As the alleyway is very
poorly lighted, the females were unable to obtain any
further description of the men, who made good their escape.

衣物。此事办妥后，1939年9月1日晚9点前不久，
死者外出并在静安寺路叫了一辆公共人力车。人力车来到
静安寺路1699弄83号的后门。

王龙辛（Ong Long Sin，即王阆仙）随后坐进人力车，他的
嫂子弟媳王徐氏（Ong Sih Oz）和妻子拿出他的行李并放到
同一辆人力车上，之后死者向她们告别并吩咐车夫出发。
女眷们回到屋内，人力车朝静安寺路方向驶去。

当人力车行驶到死者住所与弄堂入口之间约一半路程时
（静安寺路以南约50码），两名中国男性从后方接近
人力车，其中一人向死者头部后方开了一枪，随后他们
沿弄堂向南奔跑，转入一条通往海格路（Avenue Haig）的支弄。

死者的妻子和嫂子弟媳听到爆炸声后跑出来（她们声称以为
爆炸是人力车轮胎爆裂所致），看到两名男子沿弄堂向南奔跑。

描述，二人成功逃脱。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

The females ran to the ricsha and found the deceased to have been shot.

They took his luggage back into the house and Wong Hsu sat in the ricsha to hold her husband's body, after which they proceeded to O'Well Road and Avenue Haig corner where they reported the crime to P.C.600, who was on point duty. The above officer was about 100 yards away from the scene, but owing to the noises of heavy traffic at the intersection did not hear the shot. He took the ricsha to this station wherefrom the wounded man was conveyed to the Hospital.

A search was made in the vicinity, but no trace of the assailants could be found. One empty cartridge case was found at the scene of offence and will be forwarded to the A. I. Section on 2/9/39.

On examination of the deceased's clothing and luggage, five notes were found by detectives, which tend to show that he belonged to some political organisation. D.S.I. Wittinsky on duty at Special Branch, Headquarters, was communicated with and on instructions of D.I. Crawford request that the notes were sent to Special Branch on 2/9/39.

The notes together with two note-books, also found in possession of the deceased will be forwarded to Special Branch with a copy of this report.

（批：Being examined by C.D.S. Sth. C'g.）

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
commented on by investigating officer).

At 9.10 p.m. 1/9/39 S.I.C.600 brought to the
station a public riosha containing a female Hsu
sz (王許氏) and her husband Wang Long Sih
(王仙), the latter suffering from a bullet wound
in the head.

A S.P.B. Ambulance was summoned at once and
conveyed the wounded man to the Red Cross Hospital
where he was found to have a "gun shot wound of
head", as a result of which he died at 11.10 p.m.
even date.

Enquiries by C.D.S.163, C.D.C.s 150 & 168 and
the undersigned showed that the deceased was a native
of Huchow, Chekiang province, age 37, and till 1938
was employed by a native bank in Huchow. Last year
he together with his family left Huchow and in August
1938 came to Shanghai via Changsha and Hongkong and
since his arrival resided at house No.63, Lane 1699
B'well Road.

The members of his household were carefully
interrogated by detectives, but failed to supply
any useful information, stating that the deceased
did not inform them of his affairs. The deceased's
wife said that her husband expected to get some
employment at a dance-hall that was to be opened
soon, but she did not know either the names of the
promoters or the location of the said dance-hall.

At about 7 p.m. 1/9/39, the deceased came home
and told his wife that he had to go to Huchow on
2/9/39 and that he would stay overnight in a lodging
house, and asked his wife to pack his bedding and

（由负责调查的警官对任何突出或特殊的特征进行评论）。

1939年9月1日晚上9:10，巡长600号将一辆载有一名女性许氏（王許氏）及其丈夫王仙（Wang Long Sih）的公共人力车带至警署，后者头部遭受枪伤。

随即呼叫了一辆特别巡逻队救护车，将伤者送往红十字会医院，经诊断其为“头部枪伤”，并于当晚11:10因此身亡。

经侦探163号、侦探主任150号及168号以及下文签署人的调查表明，死者系浙江湖州人，现年37岁，直至1938年受雇于湖州的一家本土银行。去年，他携家人离开湖州，于1938年8月经长沙和香港抵达上海，自抵沪以来一直居住在静安寺路1699弄63号。

侦探对其家庭成员进行了仔细讯问，但未能提供任何有用信息，称死者并未向其透露自身事务。死者妻子表示，其丈夫预计将在一家即将开业的舞厅谋得职位，但她既不知晓发起人的姓名，也不知该舞厅的具体位置。

1939年9月1日晚上7点左右，死者回家并告知妻子，他须于1939年9月2日前往湖州，并将在一家旅馆过夜，要求妻子为其打包寝具和

This was done and shortly before 9 p.m. 1/9/39 the deceased went out and called a public ricksha from B'well Road. The ricksha came to the back door of house No.65, Lane 1699 B'well Road.

Wong Long Sih then sat in the ricksha, and his sister-in-law Ong Sih Ts (王徐氏) and his wife brought out his luggage and placed onto the same ricksha, after which the deceased bade them farewell and ordered the ricksha puller to go. The females returned into the house and the ricksha proceeded towards B'well Road.

When the ricksha was about half-way between the deceased's house and the entrance to the Lane (about 50 yards south of B'well Road) two male Chinese, approached the ricksha from behind and one of them fired a shot at the back of the deceased's head, after which they ran south along the lane, turning into a branch-lane leading to Avenue Haig.

The deceased's wife and sister-in-law heard the explosion and ran out (they claim they believed the explosion was caused by burst ricksha tire) and saw two men running south along the lane. One of the men was wearing white jacket and pants, whilst the other wore dark coloured jacket and pants. As the alleyway is very poorly lighted, the females were unable to obtain any further description of the men, who made good their escape. | |

CHINA PRESS.
SEP 2 1939
24456
Terrorist Guns
Claim 2 More
Victims Here

Doctor Murdered While
Leaving Residence
Of Patient

Terrorist guns claimed two more victims in Shanghai yesterday. One man is dead while another was so seriously wounded that he is not expected to live.

The dead man was Dr. Tsang Dao, 29-year-old local medical practitioner. He was shot and killed by an unknown Chinese gunman as he left the home of a patient at 191 Rue Magniny about 3 p.m.

The wounded man is Wong Teng-chi, 37, occupation still unknown. He was wounded by two killers while he happened to be walking along Lane 1689 Bubbling Well Road about 9.20 p.m.

Struck In Back

Wong, according to late police reports, was struck in the back by a bullet fired from a military Mauser. The missile embedded itself, through some strange trick, in the man's skull.

This shooting was not witnessed by the police but several passersby happened to be in the district, and saw the two killers escape from the scene. They placed the wounded in a ricksha and took him to the Bubbling Well Police Station.

From the station, he was sent to the Chinese Red Cross Hospital where an effort to save his life was still being made at midnight. Little hope, however, is held for his recovery.

Detectives of the Bubbling Well Police Station last night had made but little progress in determining Wong's occupation, or finding out anything about his past. The man himself was too weak to do much talking, hence he could throw no light on the shooting. It is believed, however, that he was the victim of a political shooting. The man was neatly dressed although nothing that would indicate that he might be a person of means was to be found on his person.

Dr. Tsang Dao, residing at House 8, Lane 312 Avenue Joffre, was called to the home of a patient at 191 Rue Magniny about 2 p.m. yesterday. As he left the place at 3 p.m., a Chinese who had been loitering outside, followed the physician to the curb.

Motive Unknown

The doctor entered a ricksha and told the puller to take him back to his home on Avenue Joffre. Just as the puller started off, the loiterer produced a pistol and opened fire. One bullet struck the doctor in the neck and another in the chest. He died on the way to the hospital.

His crime accomplished, the assassin dashed to the curb and jumped on a bicycle. He rode away in a westerly direction according to an account furnished by an eye-witness.

Detectives of the French Police last night admitted that they had not been unable to unearth a definite motive for the crime. The doctor was comparatively unknown in Shanghai. He had a small practice and had evidently resided here for only a short period. It is generally believed, however, that a political motive was back of the murder.

《字林西报》。
1939年9月2日
24456
恐怖分子枪击
在此再夺两命

医生离开病人寓所时遭谋杀

昨日，恐怖分子的枪口在上海又夺去了两条生命。一人死亡，另一人伤势过重，预计难以存活。

死者为曾道（Tsang Dao）医生，29岁，本地执业医师。下午3点左右，他在迈尔西爱路（Rue Magniny）191号离开一位病人家中时，被一名身份不明的中国枪手射杀。

伤者名为王腾吉（Wong Teng-chi），37岁，职业尚不清楚。晚上9点20分左右，他在静安寺路1689弄行走时，偶遇两名杀手并遭其枪击受伤。

背部中弹

根据警方最新报告，王某背部被一支军用毛瑟枪射出的子弹击中。这颗子弹以某种奇特的方式嵌入其头骨。

警方并未目击此次枪击事件，但当时有几名路人恰好在附近，目睹了两名杀手逃离现场。他们将伤者安置在一辆人力车上，并将其送往静安寺警署。

从警署出发，他被送往中国红十字会医院，直至午夜时分，院方仍在努力抢救其生命。然而，其康复希望渺茫。

昨晚，静安寺警署的侦探在确定王某的职业或查明其过往方面进展甚微。此人身体过于虚弱，无法多言，因此未能就枪击事件提供线索。不过，据信他是政治性枪击事件的受害者。该男子衣着整洁，但其身上未发现任何能表明其可能为富裕人士的物品。

曾道医生居住于霞飞路312弄8号，昨日下午2点左右被召至迈尔西爱路191号的一位病人家中。下午3点当他离开该处时，一名一直在外徘徊的中国人跟随医生至路边。

动机不明

医生登上人力车，吩咐车夫送他返回霞飞路的家中。就在车夫刚要出发时，那名徘徊者掏出手枪开火。一颗子弹击中医生颈部，另一颗击中胸部。他在送往医院的途中身亡。

刺客完成罪行后，冲至路边跳上一辆自行车。据一名目击者所述，他向西骑行离去。

法国警察局的侦探昨晚承认，他们尚未能查明该犯罪的确切动机。这位医生在上海相对无名。他的诊所规模很小，显然在此居住时间不长。然而，人们普遍认为这起谋杀背后存在政治动机。

SHANGHAI TIMES.

SEP 2 1939

CHINESE SHOT AT IN
BUBBLING WELL

Lingers Between Life
And Death In Red
Cross Hospital

As a sequel to an attempted mur-
der, another male Chinese named
Wang Liang-hsi, aged 35, a native
of Wuchow, was hovering between
life and death in the Red Cross
Chinese Hospital at a late hour last
night with a bullet wound in his
head.

Wang was walking in Lane 1699
Bubbling Well Road, when one of
two unidentified armed men, fired
three shots at him, only one bullet
hitting its intended mark. The
gunmen immediately fled and made
good their escape.

The motive of the attempted mur-
der was still being investigated by
Bubbling Well Station police up till
late last night.

The victim, was rushed to the
hospital in an ambulance. He was
still half-conscious, but unable to
make a coherent statement, and
hence it had not yet been ascertain-
ed up till late last night as to his
occupation, or whether he knew
the attempted murderers.

Doctors attending Wang feared
that there was little chances of his
recovery.

《上海泰晤士报》。

1939年9月2日

静安寺路发生华人枪击案

伤者于红十字会医院生命垂危

继一起谋杀未遂案之后，另一名名为王良熙（Wang Liang-hsi，音译）的35岁华籍男子，梧州人，头部中弹，于昨夜深夜在红十字会华人医院生命垂危。

王某当时正行走在静安寺路1699弄，两名身份不明的持枪男子中的一人向他开了三枪，仅有一发子弹击中目标。枪手随即逃离现场并成功脱身。

直至昨夜深夜，静安寺巡捕房警方仍在调查这起谋杀未遂案的动机。

受害者由救护车紧急送往医院。他当时仍半清醒，但无法做出连贯陈述，因此直至昨夜深夜，其职业以及是否认识谋杀未遂者等情况尚未查明。

为王某诊治的医生担心，其康复希望渺茫。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

SEP 2 1939

Chinese Shot Dead
In Settlement
Third Murder in Sixteen
Hours Claims Former Bank
Employee as Victim

Shanghai's third murder in sixteen
hours took place at 9.37 last night
when Wang Laung-sih, 37-year old
former employee of the Bank of
China, was shot and fatally wounded
in the head by an unknown gunman
in Lane 1699 Bubbling Well Road.
Wang died in the Red Cross Hospital
at 11.10 last night.
The dead man had left his home
at House 83. Lane 1699, Bubbling
Well Road, and was proceeding in the
direction of the street when he was
accosted by two men dressed in Chin-
ese clothing. One of them was report-
ed to have whipped out a pistol and
fired one shot at Wang, wounding
him in the head. The killer and his
accomplice then made good their
escape.
Wang was formerly employed by
the Bank of China in Hongkong. He
came to Shanghai about a year ago
but had been unable to find em-
ployment. He was engaged in a small
business dealing in second-hand
goods and was also reported to have
been connected with a local gambling
establishment. Police from Bubbling
Well Station who are investigating
the case do not believe that it was
a political murder. The motive
behind the killing is thought to be
revenge.

《字林西报》。

1939年9月2日

租界内华人被枪杀
十六小时内第三起命案，前银行职员遇难

上海十六小时内的第三起谋杀案发生于昨晚9时37分，时年37岁的前中国银行职员王良熙（Wang Laung-sih，音译）在静安寺路1699弄被一名不明身份的枪手击中头部，受致命伤。王某于昨晚11时10分在红十字会医院身亡。

死者此前离开其位于静安寺路1699弄83号的住所，正朝街道方向行走时，被两名身穿中式服装的男子拦住。据称，其中一人掏出手枪向王某开了一枪，击中其头部。凶手及其同伙随后成功逃脱。

王某此前受雇于香港的中国银行。他约于一年前来到上海，但一直未能找到工作。他从事二手货物的小本生意，另有消息称他与当地一家赌博场所有关联。正在调查此案的静安寺巡捕房警方认为，这并非政治谋杀。据信，杀人动机为报复。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.

SEP 2 1939

Chinese Doctor Killed
In French Concession
Unknown Assassin Fires
Two Shots at Physician

Dr. Tsang Dao, alias Tsang Hong-seng, 29-year old Chinese doctor of medicine, was brutally murdered as he stepped out of the home of a patient at 160 Route Magniny at 4 o'clock yesterday afternoon, by an unknown Chinese assassin who made his escape on a bicycle immediately after the killing. The killer fired two shots from a pistol at Dr. Tsang, wounding him in the head and in the abdomen. He was rushed to Ste. Marie's Hospital by ambulance but was pronounced dead upon arrival.

French Concession police who are investigating the murder are of the opinion that there was nothing political connected with the killing. Chinese circles are of the belief that it was another case of the "eternal triangle" and that the motive for the crime was jealousy. The dead man is survived by his wife and the affair was made more tragic in that she is an expectant mother. Dr. Tsang and his wife lived at House 8, Lane 312, Avenue Joffre.

《字林西报》。

1939年9月2日

法租界内华籍医生遇害
不明刺客向医师连开两枪

曾道（Tsang Dao，音译）医生，又名曾洪生（Tsang Hong-seng，音译），29岁，华籍医学博士，于昨日下午4时在迈尔西爱路（Route Magniny）160号一患者寓所出门时，遭一名不明身份的华籍刺客残忍杀害，凶手作案后立即骑自行车逃离。凶手用手枪向曾医生连开两枪，击中其头部和腹部。曾医生由救护车紧急送往圣玛丽医院（Ste. Marie's Hospital），但抵达时被宣布死亡。

正在调查此谋杀案的法租界警方认为，该杀人案与政治无关。华人圈子则认为这是另一起“三角关系”案件，犯罪动机是嫉妒。死者遗有妻子，且其妻身怀有孕，更令此事显得悲惨。曾医生与其妻居住于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）312弄8号。

24435
SHANGHAI TIMES.

SEP 2 1939

DOCTOR MURDERED IN
FRENCHTOWN

Four Shots Fired As
Surgeon Returns
To His Home

'Guns barked again on the streets
of Shanghai last evening, in spite
of constant strict police surveillance
and the searching of buses and
trams At 4 o'clock yesterday
afternoon, Dr. Tsang Dao, aged 29,
a surgeon, was shot to death by an
unknown assassin shortly after he
had left the residence of a patient
at 160 Route Magniny.

Three or four shots were fired
at him, one bullet lodging in his
face, near the nose, while another
struck the abdomen. The doctor
was riding in a private ricsha when
the gunman opened fire on him
without the slightest warning. The
puller dropped the shafts at the
sound of the shots and the passenger
slumped to the ground. The gun-
man who fired the shots succeeded
in making good his escape on a
bicycle, immediately turning off into
a side street.

The victim was proceeding from
a patient's home to his private re-
sidence at House No. 8, Lane 812,
Avenue Joffre, when he was mur-
dered in cold blood.

No witnesses were present at the
scene with the exception of the
ricsha puller who did not get a good
look at the gunman and who was
taken by complete surprise. Dr.
Tsang had no enemies as far as it
known. French Police are conduct-
ing investigations.
pages.zh:
24435
《上海泰晤士报》。

1939年9月2日

法大马路发生医生谋杀案

外科医生返家途中遭遇四声枪响

尽管警方持续严密监控并对公共汽车和有轨电车进行搜查，昨晚上海的街道上再次响起枪声。昨日下午4时，29岁的外科医生曾道（Tsang Dao，音译）在离开迈尔西爱路（Route Magniny）160号的一处患者寓所后不久，被一名不明身份的刺客枪杀。

有人向他开了三四枪，一颗子弹嵌入其面部靠近鼻子处，另一颗击中腹部。医生当时正乘坐一辆私人黄包车，枪手毫无预警地向他开火。车夫听到枪声后扔下车把，乘客瘫倒在地。开枪的枪手成功骑自行车逃脱，随即转入一条小街。

受害者当时正从一位患者家中前往其位于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）812弄8号的私人住所，途中惨遭冷血谋杀。

除黄包车夫外，现场没有目击者，而车夫并未看清枪手，且完全猝不及防。据所知，曾医生并无仇敌。法国警方正在进行调查。
